# DPD File Format:
#
# <NUM_AMAM>
# <NUM_AMPM>
# <NUM_EPDT>
# <AMAM[0]>
# . . .
# <AMAM[NUM_AMAM]
# <AMPM[0]> 
# . . .
# <AMPM[NUM_AMPM]>
# <EPDT[0]> 
# . . .
# <EPDT[NUM_EPDT]>
#
# NOTE: If num_epdt equals 0 then do not include epdt values in the file
#       Empty line are no allowed
#       Comments are allowed only at the beginning of the file and must be by'#'
#       Comments are not allowed on the same line as the data
